node.title: Alerta y respuesta
node.summary: A warning detects a possible deviation and a response acts on it.

relations: The early-warning distinction between detection and response could clarify when an additional control helps or burdens operations.
El governor teórico no prueba que relajar compliance sea seguro. Las obligaciones duras no se someten a una media de utilidad.
A regime signal matters operationally only when its evidence, response window and authorized action are specified, not merely when another alarm layer is added.
La correlación de errores depende del caso; no asumir identidad probabilística entre capas ni una alerta universalmente no inferior.
Regime evidence becomes operationally useful only when its timing and qualification support a feasible, authorized response.
El anexo no acredita un detector validado ni una integración común ya ejecutada.
